rationale: No existing spec covers the Performance Dashboard API tab. The closest candidate is rum-page-dataflow.spec.js, which only tests the Overview tab's summary loading resolution (pm.rumPerformancePage.gotoPerformance / clickRefresh / expectSummaryLoadingResolved). The API tab (ApiDashboard.vue) has its own component tree, selectors, data-fetching paths, and the 'black space on time-range change' behaviour that are entirely unexercised. A new spec in RegressionSet/General is warranted for this regressions/bug-fix feature.
